journey.name: MedBot evidence-gated offline preview
journey.description: Specification only. Verify evidence prerequisites before any clinical or model claim. Do not continue when a real input is unavailable.

preconditions.precondition: Real debug APK is installed on an identified emulator or physical device.
ADB identifies device serial, Android API level, and OEM before execution.

actions.action: Verify a non-empty user-supplied .litertlm file is readable and can be initialized by LiteRT-LM.
Verify a user-selected medical document URI is readable.
Verify a user-selected photo URI is readable.
Only after all prerequisites are available, observe the real app and record output without inventing model, document, or photo results.

outcomeRules.rule: BLOCKED; stop; no screenshot or success claim.
Record device metadata, observed UI, and fresh screenshot separately from unit/build evidence.
